items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: we brought in a guy from Richmond, Virginia... Henry Southall

ctx.x: Jake was there, constantly, and Nat Pierce and Chase was there every night, through the whole -- and if we got different trumpet players at different times, they were usually guys from Boston or New York area, who'd been in the band, or -- that was his department. And then the trombones, it was sometime during that earliest time, when we brought in a guy from Richmond, Virginia --
